name: Fel Rift: Altar of Storms spawns its portal and teleports the caster (#5166, #4185)
contract: Fel Rift: Altar of Storms 535603 is a FelswornRifts entry (AscensionFelswornData.h) whose single effect is SPELL_EFFECT_TRANS_DOOR (50) with raw DBC EffectMiscValue[0] 1005760 - not a real gameobject_template entry. AscensionFelsworn::ApplyContracts is meant to rewrite it to the rift's real GO entry (9000147, inserted by rev_20260909_05_felsworn_completion.sql, ScriptName go_ascension_felsworn_rift), which Spell::EffectTransmitted then spawns via sObjectMgr->GetGameObjectTemplate(Effects[0].MiscValue) at TARGET_DEST_CASTER_FRONT. Before the fix, ApplyContracts returned on `info->SpellFamilyName != 20` before ever reaching the rift-patch loop (535603 carries SpellFamilyName 0, confirmed via coa-dbc-viewer), so MiscValue stayed 1005760, no matching gameobject_template existed, and EffectTransmitted spawned nothing - exactly 'no portal produced'. go_ascension_felsworn_rift::OnGossipHello teleports the clicking owner to the rift's FelswornRifts row (map 0, -7616.9, -744.571, 190.288) on a successful click.
